chunks: 4590 - And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated, saying:

I wrote to him asking about a man who contracted mutʿah with a woman, then gifted her her days before consummating with her, or gifted her her days after he had consummated with her. Does he have the right to revoke what he gifted her from that?
So he, peace be upon him, wrote in reply: “He does not take it back.”

key_terms.أَيَّامَهَا: the remaining days of her marriage term
key_terms.يُفْضِيَ: to consummate or have intimate access

ai.seo_question: Can a man revoke the remaining days he gifted to a woman in a mutʿah marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning mutʿah marriage and the gifting of the remaining term to the woman. It states that once the man has granted her those days, whether before or after consummation, he cannot revoke that grant.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
He wrote to Imam (as) asking about a man who engaged in Mutah (temporary marriage) with a woman and then gifted her the remaining days of the contract before consummating the marriage or after consummating it.
He asked whether the man could revoke what he had gifted her from those days.
The Imam (as) replied: "He cannot take it back."
